newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela sets 90 bln bolivar TEM bill auction.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela sets 90 bln bolivar TEM bill auction.

text.p: The Central Bank of Venezuela announced for Wednesday morning a 90 billion bolivar auction of 179-, 268- and 358-day "monetary stabilization," or TEM, bills at nominal interest rates of up to 17.15 percent.

The bank said it would offer 50 billion bolivars worth of 179-day bills at a nominal interest rate of 16.47 percent, 20 billion bolivars of 268-day bills at 16.81 percent and 20 billion bolivars of 358-day bills at 17.15 percent.
At its auction last week, the central bank sold 90 billion bolivars worth of 180-, 269- and 358-day bills with yields of 16.48 percent, 18.81 percent and 19.60 percent respectively.
